script: Kya aapko pata hai Krishna ki bachpan ki kahaniyon mein se ek sabse prachin aur romanchak kahani hai jab unhone apne mitron ke saath chhup-chhup kar maakhan churaya tha? Ek baar, Gokul gaon mein Krishna aur unke saathi maakhan ke liye maange hue gharo mein jaate the. Krishna ke shaitani tareeke aur unki chamakdaar muskaan sabko prabhavit kar deti thi. Ek din, unke mitron ne kaha ki unhe sabse uchai par rakha matki ka maakhan chahiye. Krishna ne apni choti ungli se is musibat ko hal kar diya. Sab bachhe neechi matki ke paas ikattha hue, Krishna ne unhe upar chadhaya aur khud sabse upar chadh gaye. Aise hi Krishna ne sabko dikhaya ki kaise unki shakti aur buddhi se har musibat ko hal kiya ja sakta hai. Yeh kahani sirf unke shaitani tareekeon ki nahi, par unki dosti aur samajhdaari ki bhi hai. Krishna ke is avtaar ko dekh kar gaon wale bhi unki bhakti karne lage. Unhone sabko sikhaya ki dosti aur samajhdaari se hum har chunauti ko paar kar sakte hain. Aapko yeh kahani kaisi lagi? Agar aapko aur bhi aise hi kahaniyan sunni hai, toh humein follow karein aur banein hamare saath is adbhut yatra mein.
